label: Structured W256 self-attention - frozen 64-key W512 teacher embeddings directly compressed - K1=K2=2 x59 - S16 centers affine256 R128 reset - layer2 h512 + 3 independent layer13 h512 - replacement gate 0.99 step0.01 - 256 epochs - batch10240 - EMA4

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: Every residual position owns independent parameters; its weights are shared across forecast seconds only. Registers reset independently at each forecast second.
architecture.initialState: the first observed W embedding seeds M and P with two unnumbered GNGLUs; shared layer 3 produces F and shared layer 4 produces PF
architecture.outputState: Encode true future full59 states with the frozen teacher layer1 and unit-RMS normalization. Replace them linearly with 16 independently sampled teacher component-center embeddings (512 each), using prior softmax masses and no Gaussian jitter. Concat8192 -> learned affine256; concatenate reset R128; conditioned layer2 then 3 independently learned stream-only layer13 blocks; existing affine unembedding to 16x59 outputs. No intermediate embedding-to-feature decoder and no state carry across forecast seconds.
architecture.latentSemantics: P, F, PF, and NF remain unconstrained latent embeddings in this experiment; no probability decoder or density loss is imposed

hindsightConditioning.initialization: Learned zero R128; mean-pooled random affine512-to256 initialization shared across the 16 sample positions, freely learned thereafter; existing final affine256-to59 initialized identically across sample outputs. No exact feature passthrough is assumed. Small layer2/layer13 residual projections as before.

loss.description: Mean standardized MSE over examples, both forecast steps, every decoded sample, and all59 channels. Predictions are averaged only for reported metrics and the correlation gate; not before the training loss.

hindsightNoiseSchedule.advance: check once after each complete epoch; if threshold met, increment variance once for the next epoch, capped at 1; otherwise hold indefinitely within the run epoch budget
hindsightNoiseSchedule.corruption: z=(1-v)*frozen_teacher_encode(true_features)+v*sampled_frozen_teacher_component_center; v is replacement fraction, not Gaussian variance. Endpoint v=1 never reads targets.
hindsightNoiseSchedule.prediction: One corruption level and one forward pass; conditioned layer2 then independently learned stream-only layer13 residual blocks. No extra diffusion iteration.

sampling.description: original dense chronological clean-origin dataset with exact-zero next-return targets excluded
sampling.comparisonControl: Fresh seed1337 student with original dense train256000 and K1=K2=2, same 3-layer13/S16/affine256/0.99 gate controls; frozen teacher embedding prior replaces raw-feature Gaussian corruption. The retained teacher trained on the same training split, so training-gate results are not out-of-fold; held-out forecasting is the performance criterion.

evaluation.headline: step-1 next completed 1s signed log return
evaluation.checkpointSelection: teacher-only validation step-1 next-return MSE and correlation; test never selects
evaluation.hindsight: Forecast evaluation uses replacement fraction1 with deterministic split-specific component sampling and no targets. Training-only current-fraction reconstruction gates advances. Validation current-fraction reconstruction is target-assisted and diagnostic only.

alignment.input: two consecutive timeline rows ending at each clean example origin
alignment.target: the two complete chronological timeline rows at origin+1 and origin+2
alignment.futureExtension: K1 uses consecutive rows ending at origin; K2 uses consecutive rows starting at origin+1
alignment.attentionCausality: output step s attends only to generated NF states at output steps <= s
